title: Find the Maximum Factor Score of Array
summary: Given an integer array, calculate the factor score of the array after removing at most one element.
statement: Given an integer array, calculate the factor score of the array after removing at most one element. The factor score is the product of the least common multiple and greatest common divisor of all elements. The score of an empty array is 0.
constraints: A nonempty array scores gcd(all values) multiplied by lcm(all values); the empty array scores zero.
Remove at most one element and return the largest score.
hints: Removing one position combines the aggregates strictly before and after it.
Precompute suffix GCD/LCM, then sweep a prefix pair of aggregates.
Start with the keep-all score; for each removal combine prefix and suffix using identities GCD 0 and LCM 1.
Associativity of GCD and LCM makes the two sides exactly equal to aggregating every retained element.
editorial: Associativity of GCD and LCM makes the two sides exactly equal to aggregating every retained element.

tests.explanation: Removing two leaves GCD 4 and LCM 16, for a score of 64.
Keeping every value gives GCD 1 and LCM 60, which is optimal.
